text:
If sleep were (as they say) a
+
+truce, a pure repose of mind,
+
+why, if you are suddenly awakened,
+
+do you feel they have stolen a fortune from you?
+
+
+Why is it so sad to rise at dawn? The hour
+
+strips us of an inconceivable gift,
+
+so intimate it can be translated only
+
+into a drowsiness that waking gilds
+
+
+with dreams, which may well be broken
+
+reflections of the treasures of shadow,
+
+of a timeless realm that has no name
+
+
+and that day deforms in its mirrors.
+
+Who will you be tonight in the dark
+
+dream, on the other side of its wall?

translation.title: The Dream
translation.editorial_note: Dream remains treasure, translation, and damaged reflection of a nameless realm; the final question addresses the unknown self beyond sleep’s wall.
